description: submit an executed step's result for validation: only a valid observation is durably recorded and advances pull-mode execution — an invalid one changes nothing and returns the full error list.
embedding_description: Report back what happened when an agent executed a work breakdown structure step externally. The platform validates the observation — right step order, declared process key, success-status result envelope — and only then records it durably and advances. Rejected observations change no state and return every validation error.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Observation outcome with keys: wbs_id, step_number, accepted, errors, next
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with accepted. When false, list every entry of errors verbatim — the driver repairs and re-submits. Then present the next envelope.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: If accepted, continue with the step described in next. If rejected, fix the listed problems (usually: wrong step order, undeclared process key, or a non-success result) and re-execute or re-submit; state did not advance.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Recording an executed step's outcome in pull mode. record_wbs_step_observation accepts {wbs_id, step_number, process_key, result, state_summary?, output_artifacts?}. Validation failures come back in the RESULT's errors list with accepted=false, not as raised errors.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFound: no WBS tracking row or document exists for this wbs_id. ValidationError: the action arguments do not conform to the schema (note: observation-content findings are returned in the result, not raised).
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Argument-shape failures: fix the action arguments and resubmit. Observation rejections (accepted=false): follow the errors list — re-fetch the envelope with get_next_wbs_step if unsure where execution stands.
